data.name: HelpText
data.value: Status lists the Ethernet and Wi-Fi devices and what each is connected to. Known Networks are the Wi-Fi networks this computer has joined. Those set to connect automatically are joined whenever they are in range, the highest priority first. A network available to all users keeps its password with NetworkManager; one that is not is yours alone, with its password in your keyring. To join a new network, use the Wi-Fi icon's menu in the tray.
